All names, addresses, amounts, and terms in this document are invented.
This is not a real lease and is not legal advice.
RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT
Juniper Row Apartments
This Lease Agreement ("Lease") is entered into on December 10, 2026 between Larkspur Property Management, LLC, as agent for the owner ("Landlord"), and Alex Rivera and Jamie Chen ("Resident"), for the dwelling described below.

clauses.heading: Premises
clauses.text: Premises. Unit 3B, a 2 bedroom / 1 bath apartment at 1450 Fictional Avenue, Salt Lake City, Utah ("Premises").

clauses.heading: Term
clauses.text: Term. This Lease begins January 1, 2027 and ends December 31, 2027 ("Term").

clauses.heading: Occupancy
clauses.text: Occupancy. The Premises may be occupied only by the persons named in this Lease. Maximum occupancy is two (2) persons. A guest may stay no more than 14 days in any 6-month period without Landlord's written consent.

clauses.heading: Security Deposit
clauses.text: Security Deposit. Resident will pay a security deposit of $1,000.00 at signing. Landlord may deduct from the deposit a carpet cleaning charge of $150.00 at move-out regardless of the carpet's condition, plus any unpaid amounts and any damage beyond normal wear and tear.

clauses.heading: Administrative Fee
clauses.text: Administrative Fee. Resident will pay a non-refundable administrative fee of $250.00 at signing.

clauses.heading: Application Fee
clauses.text: Application Fee. A non-refundable application fee of $45.00 per adult applicant was paid before this Lease was signed.

clauses.heading: Access Devices
clauses.text: Access Devices. Resident will receive two (2) key fobs for a deposit of $25.00 each, refundable when the fobs are returned in working condition. A lost or damaged fob will be replaced for $60.00 each.

clauses.heading: First Month
clauses.text: First Month. The first month's rent and all monthly charges are due at signing.

clauses.heading: Base Rent
clauses.text: Base Rent. Base rent is $2,100.00 per month, due on the first (1st) day of each month. Rent will remain fixed for the Term.

clauses.heading: Rent Schedule
clauses.text: Rent Schedule. The rent schedule in Exhibit A is part of this Lease.

clauses.heading: Late Charges
clauses.text: Late Charges. If rent is not received by the end of the third (3rd) day of the month, Resident will pay a late fee equal to five percent (5%) of monthly base rent, plus $15.00 for each additional day the rent remains unpaid.

clauses.heading: Returned Payments
clauses.text: Returned Payments. A fee of $40.00 applies to any returned or declined payment.

clauses.heading: Payment Method
clauses.text: Payment Method. Payments by credit or debit card carry a convenience fee of 2.9% of the payment. Payment by ACH or check carries no fee.

clauses.heading: Reserved Parking
clauses.text: Reserved Parking. Resident must lease one (1) reserved parking space at $100.00 per month. A second space, if available, is $75.00 per month. Guest parking is limited. Unauthorized vehicles may be towed at the vehicle owner's expense.

clauses.heading: Community Amenity Fee
clauses.text: Community Amenity Fee. Resident will pay $45.00 per month for use of the fitness room, clubhouse, and courtyard, whether or not Resident uses them.

clauses.heading: Technology Package
clauses.text: Technology Package. Resident will pay $65.00 per month for the community internet service, which is required for all units.

clauses.heading: Pest Control
clauses.text: Pest Control. Resident will pay $8.00 per month for pest control services.

clauses.heading: Valet Trash
clauses.text: Valet Trash. Resident will pay $25.00 per month for doorstep trash collection.

clauses.heading: Utilities
clauses.text: Utilities. Water, sewer, and storm water charges are billed back to Resident using a ratio utility billing method, currently estimated at approximately $70.00 per month for a two-person household, plus a billing service fee of $5.00 per month. Resident is responsible for electricity and natural gas, which are billed directly to Resident by the utility providers.

clauses.heading: Renter's Insurance
clauses.text: Renter's Insurance. Resident must maintain renter's insurance with at least $100,000 in liability coverage and provide proof before move-in. If proof is not provided, Landlord may enroll Resident in a Landlord-placed policy at $14.00 per month.

clauses.heading: Additional Charges
clauses.text: Additional Charges. Landlord may add or change fees for services such as package handling, amenity upgrades, or technology enhancements upon thirty (30) days' written notice to Resident.

clauses.heading: Pets
clauses.text: No pets are allowed without a signed Pet Addendum. If a pet is approved, pet rent is $35.00 per month per pet and a refundable pet deposit of $300.00 per pet applies.

clauses.heading: Community Rules
clauses.text: Resident agrees to follow the Community Rules, as amended by Landlord from time to time. The Community Rules are available at the leasing office. Violations may result in fines set by Landlord.

clauses.heading: Maintenance and Entry
clauses.text: Landlord will make repairs to the Premises in a reasonable time after written notice. Resident will pay for repairs needed because of damage caused by Resident or Resident's guests.

clauses.heading: Maintenance and Entry
clauses.text: Landlord may enter the Premises with at least twenty-four (24) hours' notice, or at any time in an emergency.

clauses.heading: Subletting and Assignment
clauses.text: Resident may not sublet the Premises or assign this Lease without Landlord's prior written consent, which Landlord may withhold in its discretion. If Landlord consents, a transfer fee of $150.00 applies.

clauses.heading: Liability of Residents
clauses.text: If more than one person signs this Lease, each is jointly and severally liable for the full rent and all other obligations under this Lease. If one Resident moves out, the remaining Resident(s) remain responsible for the entire amount.

clauses.heading: Early Termination
clauses.text: Resident may end this Lease before the end of the Term by giving at least sixty (60) days' written notice and paying an early termination fee equal to two (2) months' base rent. Resident remains responsible for rent and charges through the end of the notice period.

clauses.heading: Early Termination
clauses.text: The early termination fee is in addition to any unpaid charges and deposit deductions.

clauses.heading: Renewal and Holdover
clauses.text: At the end of the Term, this Lease converts to a month-to-month tenancy unless Resident gives written notice of intent to vacate at least sixty (60) days before the end of the Term. Month-to-month base rent is the then-current base rent plus $250.00 per month.

clauses.heading: General
clauses.text: This Lease is the entire agreement between Landlord and Resident. Changes must be in writing and signed by both parties, except as stated in Section 4.8.

clauses.heading: Rent Schedule
clauses.text:
Months 1 through 6 (January 2027 to June 2027): $2,100.00 per month
Months 7 through 12 (July 2027 to December 2027): $2,150.00 per month

Landlord: ______________________ (Larkspur Property Management, LLC, fictional)
Resident: ______________________ (Alex Rivera, fictional)
Resident: ______________________ (Jamie Chen, fictional)
*** END OF FICTIONAL SAMPLE DOCUMENT ***
